name: Chadwick's
notes: Interpretation: a classic one-story diner filling the Atlas footprint: a full-width dining room across the front with a continuous band of big windows (stainless mullions, see-through glass), cream enamel and a red stripe, a rounded stainless roof edge, a glass entry vestibule and deep red canvas awnings; inside a checkerboard floor, booths along the windows, a counter with eleven stools, a back bar and lit pendants; a painted-block kitchen behind with rooftop units. The Atlas height (12 m) is far above a one-story diner; the model is 5.0 m. No sign or name on the building.
